notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only description of the tower itself is one line in a volunteer's list of Ontario towers (pulled over, left to rot in bush). Build date, height, design and staffing were not found in two searches and about five page reads, so the story leaves them out. Brief agency text is supported by source 2. Canada Lookouts' Margaret page gives only the place name, so it is not cited. The brief has no local_unit; Wikipedia places Biscotasing in the Unorganized North Part of Sudbury District, which could be added. The brief coordinates (47.2589, -82.12289) are about 5 km south of the town coordinates in Wikipedia's infobox (47 17 58 N, 82 06 15 W). The tower's own position was not checked against any map.
